entities.summary: Raja Ali Haji bin Raja Haji Ahmad (1808–1873) was a 19th-century Bugis-Malay historian, poet and scholar who wrote Tuhfal al-Nafis. Haji has been described as one of the most important Malay writers of the 19th century.
